Name: MisoMegu's Tanuki
Author: MisoMegu
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/qtS5UxW.png[/img]
─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Oh no! The Tanuki have infiltrated Marnie's Shop and trying to take the fox's place!
They are looking for a farm to sneak into so they can dig up their hops to make wine with!
Any farmer that lets the tanuki in will be rewarded with gold and treasures. (Hopefully it's real and not just a leaf to trick you.)

I had a few people request a actual tanuki mod after seeing them sneak into the foxes mod so here they are! There are 23 colors of Tanuki and they will bring you hops and gold ore. When you max out their hearts they might even bring you wine! 


─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Compatible with 1.6
Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]If you don't want to play Tanuki Gacha, I recommend a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] so you can manually chose the tanuki you want.
I am always open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!﻿
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!
